definitions.gloss: talented; versatile; gifted in many areas
definitions.explanation: Having many talents or abilities across different fields. Describes someone who excels in multiple areas rather than just one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多才|たさい}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{多才|たさい}な⟦アーティスト→アーティスト：10712_aatisuto⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧で、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多才|たさい}な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧だ。
examples.english: He is good at music, art, and writing — a truly versatile person.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a な-adjective to describe people with multiple talents. Often appears in the four-character compound {多芸多才|たげいたさい} (many arts and many talents), which is more emphatic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多才|たさい}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (talented person)
- {多才|たさい}な⟦{芸術家|げいじゅつか}→芸術家：14979_geijutsuka⟧ (versatile artist)
- {多芸多才|たげいたさい} (many arts and many talents)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多彩|たさい}→多彩：12165_tasai⟧: colorful, varied — homophone, but describes variety rather than talent
- ⟦{有能|ゆうのう}→有能：03650_yuunou⟧: capable, competent — emphasizes ability rather than breadth of talents
